subject: MAP: Technical qualification milestone — benchmark slate & owners
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@avahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 17:32:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Technical qualification milestone — benchmark slate & owners

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed MAP milestone for the technical qualification phase so we can get alignment and move to a gated PoC kickoff. Attaching a draft MAP doc for your review (map-draft-v1.pdf).

Goal: define an unambiguous "Technical evaluation" MAP milestone that both teams can sign off on before engineering resources are allocated. Proposed milestone below — please confirm owners and any missing dependencies.

Proposed milestone: Technical qualification (2–4 week lab run)
- Success criteria (must pass all):
  - Functional: model outputs meet our acceptance rubric for 6 representative prompt templates (precision/recall thresholds in attached doc).
  - Latency: p95 generation latency <= 180 ms for short chat flows (~200 tokens); p95 <= 400 ms for 2k token completion (measured with continuous batching, US-West-2).
  - Cost: amortized inference cost <= $0.35 per 1k tokens for the shortlisted model/config under expected throughput (see cost calc sheet in attachment).
  - Stability: KV-cache warming behavior demonstrated across simulated sessions (no >5% error spike on cache re-use).

Model shortlist (initial):
- redwood-rwd3-large (quantized int8) — recommended baseline
- falcon-40b-instruct (float16) — higher quality, higher cost
- meta-llama3-7b-chat (int8) — latency-focused candidate

Owners:
- AvaHealth: Emma Lawson (data & acceptance owner), Platform Team (sandbox access, sample dataset)
- Redwood: Priyom (Solutions lead/PoC PM), Ben Carter (Performance & benchmark lead), Marissa Cole (Customer Success — trial coordination)

Dependencies / blockers:
- Sample dataset (PII redaction status) and a representative prompt set from AvaHealth (due: 2027-07-05)
- SOC2 questionnaire response and entitlements for sandbox account (security team review)
- Network/VPC access or temporary API keys for isolated sandbox (if they prefer VPC, lead time 2–3 weeks)

Proposed timeline:
- Kickoff & sandbox handoff: target week of 2027-07-07
- Benchmark run: 2 weeks after sandbox ready
- Internal readout and acceptance: within 1 week of benchmark completion
- Target close / PO decision milestone: 2027-08-15

Next steps (please):
1) Emma — confirm sandbox date and whether AvaHealth requires a VPC/on-prem evaluation or if a hosted sandbox is OK.
2) Emma — share sample prompts & dataset access cadence by 2027-07-05.
3) Ben/Marissa — provide benchmark runbook & cost calc by 2027-07-02 (sending draft in follow-up).
4) I will update the MAP PDF with the agreed acceptance thresholds and owners and circulate for signature.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

– Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(priyom.das@redwood.ai)

(attachment: map-draft-v1.pdf)

From: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@avahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Platform Team <platform@avahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical qualification milestone — benchmark slate & owners

Thanks, Priyom. Useful summary — appreciate the clarity. A few clarifications from our side before we sign off: 

1) Latency measurement: can you confirm whether the proposed p95 numbers assume cold-starts or warmed KV cache? For our clinical workflows the first-turn response matters.
2) Cost: the $0.35/1k target is reasonable as a ballpark — can your cost calc include both hosted and dedicated reserved capacity estimates (we have procurement constraints that favor committed pricing)?
3) Model shortlist: we prefer to include one higher-accuracy and one latency-first model — your shortlist looks good. Can you add GPT-style instruction-following metrics so we can compare on standard prompts?

We can deliver a redacted sample dataset (10k tokens across 50 prompts) by 2027-07-05. Procurement timeline: we need vendor terms in place by mid-August to proceed with a September launch; target PO decision internal is ~2027-08-12.

We are OK to start in a hosted sandbox unless the SOC2/PHI requirements push us to a VPC. I attached the sample data scope sheet for your intake.

—Emma
VP Product, AvaHealth
emma.lawson@avahealth.com

(attachment: ava-sample-data-scope.xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@avahealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical qualification milestone — benchmark slate & owners

Emma — quick technical clarity from our performance team for the MAP acceptance criteria:

- Latency measurement: p95 targets in the MAP assume a warmed KV cache unless otherwise requested. For first-turn cold-starts we expect p95 to be ~2.5x warmed numbers; we can add an explicit cold-start metric (recommended: cold p95 <= 1s for 200-token responses). We will call out both warmed and cold baselines in the runbook.
- Measurement environment: US-West-2, batch size 8 for throughput tests; single-stream tests for interactive measurements. We'll provide the test harness configs so results are reproducible.
- Cost calc: we'll produce two sheets — hosted API pricing and a dedicated reserved capacity estimate (3-month commit to start).

Model shortlist update (operational notes):
- redwood-rwd3-large (int8) — best baseline for cost/latency tradeoff
- falcon-40b-instruct (fp16) — quality reference; expect higher cost and memory needs
- meta-llama3-7b-chat (int8) — fast and inexpensive for bursty sessions

Deliverables we will send by 2027-07-02:
- benchmark-runbook.md (includes harness, scripts, measurement configs)
- cost-calculator.xlsx (hosted vs dedicated committed pricing)

Suggested immediate next actions:
1) Priyom to schedule a 45-min kickoff on 2027-07-07 to handoff sandbox and runbook.
2) Emma to confirm whether AvaHealth will proceed with a hosted sandbox or request VPC access (we'll provide SOC2 artifacts either way).

I'll send the runbook shortly.

—Ben Carter
Senior Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

(attachment: benchmark-runbook.md)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP: Technical qualification milestone — benchmark slate & owners

Great — thanks for the quick turn, Emma. Confirming updates and locking the MAP milestone parameters based on the thread: 

Updated milestones & owners (final draft for the MAP sign-off):
- Sandbox & test harness delivered (owner: Redwood — Priyom) — target handoff: 2027-07-07
- Dataset & prompt set delivered (owner: AvaHealth — Emma) — due: 2027-07-05
- Benchmark run & initial readout (owner: Redwood — Ben) — window: 2027-07-10 to 2027-07-24
- Acceptance review & decision (owner: AvaHealth — Emma + Platform Team) — target: by 2027-08-12
- Target MAP close / PO decision: 2027-08-15 (aligned with your procurement window)

Acceptance thresholds we will include in the updated MAP PDF: warmed p95 and cold p95 for short/long flows, cost per 1k token for both hosted and dedicated scenarios, and functional pass rates for the acceptance prompt set.

Action items now:
- Ben: share runbook + cost calc by 2027-07-02.
- Emma: confirm sandbox type (hosted vs VPC) and provide dataset by 2027-07-05.
- Marissa: I asked CS to create a HubSpot milestone for the MAP (see deal link) and will drop a short sign-off mock in DocuSign if you want a formal acceptance artifact.

If these look good I'll push the updated MAP into the shared link and mark this milestone as ready for signature.

Thanks all — I'll set up the 07/07 kickoff and invite the engineering kick participants.

Best,
Priyom
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
